gui.workbay.bay.empty.tip: Hold a machine and click here to rack it.
gui.workbay.bay.inert: Nothing can reach this machine on any face. It keeps running; no link can use it.
gui.workbay.bay.locked.tip: Install an Expansion Plate to open this bay.
gui.workbay.bay.rack.tip: Hold a machine and click to rack it in this bay.
gui.workbay.bayview.chemical.tip: A Mekanism chemical. It has no bucket, so this screen shows it and a link carries it; there is nothing to click here.
gui.workbay.bayview.energy.tip: The machine's own buffer. The Workbay shares power to it automatically - there is nothing to click here.
gui.workbay.bayview.exchange.direction.t: Which way the container in the top slot carries fluid. Click to swap. The result always comes out of the bottom slot.
gui.workbay.bayview.exchange.wrong_way: Press the arrow - it is set the other way.
gui.workbay.bayview.limits: Recipe modes, side configuration and upgrade slots stay on the machine. Eject it to change those.
gui.workbay.bayview.slot.fluid: Takes a bucket or tank, which is how this machine's own fluid is filled by hand.
gui.workbay.bayview.slot.readonly: Read-only here. This machine only accepts items through a link, or from inside the bay.
gui.workbay.bayview.tank.tip: Fill it from a container in the slot below, or put an empty container there to draw from it.
gui.workbay.bayview.title: Bay View · Bay %s
gui.workbay.button.bayview.tip: Opens this machine's item slots, tanks and power so you can top it up by hand, without a link.
gui.workbay.button.copy.tip: Copies this bay's face settings, so the next seven do not have to be set by hand.
gui.workbay.button.eject.tip: Take this machine out of its bay, with everything inside it.
gui.workbay.button.enter.tip: Takes you into the bay, next to the machine, and opens its own screen - recipe modes, side configuration and upgrade slots, drawn by the mod that made it. Close it and you are back here.
gui.workbay.button.flow.tip: See what every link moves, and which flows never leave this block.
gui.workbay.button.lock.tip: A locked Workbay only lets its owner rack, eject or change anything.
gui.workbay.button.open.tip: Opens the machine's own screen - recipe modes, side configuration and upgrade slots, drawn by the mod that made it - without leaving where you stand.
gui.workbay.button.paste.tip: Replaces this bay's face settings with the ones you copied.
gui.workbay.button.rename.tip: Give this bay a name of your own. Return commits it, Escape leaves it alone, and an empty name goes back to the machine's.
gui.workbay.button.upgrades.tip: Install Expansion Plates, a Resonator or a Multichannel Upgrade.
gui.workbay.faces.empty: Rack a machine to set its faces.
gui.workbay.faces.role.input: Input. Links may push into this face.
gui.workbay.faces.role.none: Unset. With no face set, links use whichever face answers.
gui.workbay.faces.role.output: Output. Links may pull out of this face.
gui.workbay.faces.tip: The cube shows one resource type at a time, so a face can take items in and send energy out. Click a face to cycle it in, out, off; right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.filter.carrying: Click a slot to list it, anywhere else to drop it.
gui.workbay.filter.close.tip: The filter is saved as you change it. There is nothing to confirm.
gui.workbay.filter.empty: Nothing listed. This link carries everything.
gui.workbay.filter.energy.tip: A filter names an item or a fluid. Energy is a number, so there is nothing here to name.
gui.workbay.filter.entry.tip: Click to lift this off the list. Right-click to take it off without picking it up.
gui.workbay.filter.listed.allow: Only what is listed goes through.
gui.workbay.filter.listed.deny: Everything except what is listed goes through.
gui.workbay.filter.mode.tip: Whitelist carries only what is listed. Blacklist carries everything except it. Click to swap.
gui.workbay.filter.slot.tip.fluid: Click to drop what you are carrying here. A bucket or tank lists the fluid inside it; a recipe-list drag works too.
gui.workbay.filter.slot.tip.item: Click to drop what you are carrying here. With empty hands it lists what you are holding, and a recipe-list drag works too.
gui.workbay.filter.tip: Click to choose what this link may carry. With nothing listed it carries everything.
gui.workbay.flow.canvas.tip: Every link this Workbay has, as the graph it makes. Drag to move the view, scroll to zoom. Hover a box for its full name.
gui.workbay.levy.dial_off.tip: Nothing is being earned. The Assay is racked but the skim dial is at zero, so your links are keeping everything they carry.
gui.workbay.levy.name: Levy banked: %s
gui.workbay.levy.no_assay.tip: Nothing is being earned. Rack an Assay in a bay, then turn the skim dial up on the upgrades screen.
gui.workbay.levy.tip: The Assay is converting. Every batch of skimmed goods becomes one Levy, and Levy is what installs upgrades.
gui.workbay.links.add.apply.tip: Attaches everything ticked on both tabs in one go, then closes the picker.
gui.workbay.links.add.bay.tip: Makes a link straight to that bay. No Connector, no block in the world.
gui.workbay.links.add.link.tip: Hands this link to bay %s. The Connector stays where it is; only which bay it feeds changes.
gui.workbay.links.add.none.bays: No other bays. Rack a second one first.
gui.workbay.links.add.none.links: No links on other bays. Pair a Connector and place it on something.
gui.workbay.links.add.tab.tip: Connectors already standing in the world, or the bays in this rack, which need no Connector at all.
gui.workbay.links.add.tip: Lists everything this bay could be attached to: a Connector another bay is holding, or another bay directly.
gui.workbay.links.bay.tip: The bay this link moves to and from. Every link belongs to exactly one.
gui.workbay.links.disable.tip: Click to stop this link without deleting it.
gui.workbay.links.enable.tip: A new link starts off, so nothing moves until you have looked at the row. Click to turn it on.
gui.workbay.links.face.tip: Which side of the target block this link reaches into. Machines that keep their input and output in separate slots expose them on separate faces, so pin one. Any face uses whichever answers first. Right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.links.filter.tip: Click to change which links this list shows. Right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.links.internal.retarget.tip: Click to point this link at the next bay instead. Right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.links.internal.tip: Adds a link from the selected bay straight to another one, with no Connector and nothing to place in the world.
gui.workbay.links.mode.tip: Click to turn this link around.
gui.workbay.links.none: No links yet. Pair a Connector and place it on something.
gui.workbay.links.none.here: No links on this bay. %s on other bays — press Add to move one here.
gui.workbay.links.pair.tip: Pairs the Connector in your hand to this Workbay and the selected bay. Place it on the block you want linked.
gui.workbay.links.problems.tip: Click to list only the links that are in trouble. Each one is marked with a red bar and says what is wrong with it.
gui.workbay.links.remove.tip: The Connector stays where it is. Right-click it to link it again.
gui.workbay.links.rename.tip: Right-click to name this link. A name of your own is what the flow map draws instead of the target's coordinates. Return commits it, Escape leaves it alone, and an empty name goes back to the derived one.
gui.workbay.links.sort.added: In the order they were made
gui.workbay.links.sort.tip: Click to change the order. Right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.links.type.tip: Click to change what this link carries. Right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.power.tip: Energy stored in the Workbay itself. Hosted machines keep their own.
gui.workbay.redstone.always.tip: This bay's links run whatever the redstone at the Workbay is doing. Click to change; right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.redstone.pulse.tip: One operation each time the signal turns on, so a clock moves exactly one load per tick of the clock.
gui.workbay.redstone.with_signal.tip: This bay's links run only while the Workbay has a redstone signal.
gui.workbay.redstone.without_signal.tip: This bay's links run only while the Workbay has no redstone signal.
gui.workbay.skim.name: Skim: %s%% of the goods your links carry
gui.workbay.skim.no_assay.tip: Nothing is being skimmed: the rate only applies while an Assay is racked in one of this Workbay's bays.
gui.workbay.skim.row.tip: This link hands the Assay that share of the refined goods it carries, so less arrives at the far end than leaves.
gui.workbay.skim.tip: Items your links move that count as refined goods are taken at this rate and turned into Levy by the Assay. Click to raise it by five, right-click to lower it. At zero the Workbay takes nothing.
gui.workbay.status.connector_gone.tip: The Connector this link hangs off has been broken. The row clears itself shortly.
gui.workbay.status.disabled.tip: Turned off in this link's settings.
gui.workbay.status.held_by_redstone.tip: Waiting on this bay's redstone mode. Nothing is wrong; this is what you asked it to do.
gui.workbay.status.idle.tip: Nothing to move. This is the normal resting state.
gui.workbay.status.machine_no_face.tip: This bay has faces set, but none marked for this link's direction. Mark one in on the cube for a link that pulls, or out for one that sends. Setting every face back to unset uses whichever answers.
gui.workbay.status.machine_no_port.tip: The hosted machine answers on none of the faces this link may use. Many machines open a face only once you set it to input or output in their own side configuration - enter the bay and check. Run /workbay ports while looking at one to see exactly which faces answer.
gui.workbay.status.running.tip: This link moved something on its last turn.
gui.workbay.status.target_missing.tip: The dimension this link points into is gone. Nothing will move until it comes back.
gui.workbay.status.target_no_port.tip: The target is there but has nothing this link can connect to on any face.
gui.workbay.status.target_not_loaded.tip: The target's chunk is unloaded. The link resumes on its own when somebody goes back.
gui.workbay.title: Workbay
gui.workbay.upgrades.cost: Costs %s Levy, taken from this Workbay's balance when you install it. The next one costs more.
gui.workbay.upgrades.deployed.full: This network is at its limit. Placing another Workbay is refused and the item stays in your hand — break this one first, or raise maxDeployedWorkbaysPerNetwork in the server config.
gui.workbay.upgrades.deployed.tip: How many Workbay blocks of this network stand in the world. Every one of them opens onto the same bays, links and upgrades.
gui.workbay.upgrades.maxed: You have as many of these as a Workbay takes.
gui.workbay.upgrades.unaffordable: You have %s Levy and this one costs %s. Raise the skim, or move more goods through your links.
message.workbay.bay_load_timeout: The bay did not reach your client in time. Try again.
message.workbay.bay_no_screen: %s has no screen of its own.
message.workbay.bayview_unreachable: Nothing in this bay answers by hand. A machine with no slots, tanks or power is reached by a link or not at all.
message.workbay.break_warning: Breaking this Workbay leaves its bays behind. The machines keep running — place any fresh Workbay to get back in.
message.workbay.connector_full: This Connector already carries everything it can. Install a Multichannel Upgrade to carry items, fluids and energy on one.
message.workbay.connector_linked: Linked to %s. Workbay %s has a row for it, switched off until you turn it on.
message.workbay.connector_no_workbay: The Workbay this Connector is paired to isn't loaded. Go back to it and place this again.
message.workbay.connector_paired: Connector paired. Place it against the block you want to link.
message.workbay.connector_unpaired: This Connector isn't paired yet. Right-click a Workbay with it first.
message.workbay.internal_link_needs_seco: This Workbay only has one bay. Install an Expansion Plate before linking bay to bay.
message.workbay.network_cap_reached: You already own the maximum of %s Workbay network(s). Break one before starting another.
message.workbay.network_deployed_full: This network already has %s Workbay(s) placed. Break one of them before placing another.
message.workbay.network_reused: Workbay reconnected — same bays, same links, same upgrades as before.
message.workbay.pair_needs_connector: Hold a Connector to pair one.
message.workbay.reject.assay_needs_bay: The Assay only works racked in a bay. It has no faces to connect to out here.
message.workbay.reject.bay_occupied: This bay already has something standing in it. Pick an empty bay, or eject what is there first.
message.workbay.reject.empty_hand: Hold the machine you want to rack, then click the bay.
message.workbay.reject.kinetic: %s runs on rotational force. A bay can't turn a shaft.
message.workbay.reject.multiblock: %s is part of a multiblock. A bay holds one block; build it in a room instead.
message.workbay.reject.needs_neighbours: %s works by connecting to the blocks around it. A bay has no neighbours to connect to.
message.workbay.reject.no_bay: Every bay is full. Install an Expansion Plate for another.
message.workbay.reject.no_machine: %s has nothing running inside it. A bay can only hold a block with a block entity.
message.workbay.reject.no_ports: %s has no item, fluid or energy ports. A bus would have nothing to connect to.
message.workbay.reject.not_a_block: %s isn't a block. A bay holds machines.
message.workbay.reject.pack_denied: This pack doesn't allow %s to be hosted.
message.workbay.reject.rack_failed: %s wouldn't stand up in a bay, so nothing was placed. You still have it.
message.workbay.reject.recursion: A Workbay can't go inside a Workbay.
message.workbay.reject.world_interacting: %s works on the world around it. A bay is empty, so it would have nothing to do.
message.workbay.room_created: Workbay network created and bound to your account. Lose the block and a fresh, uncrafted Workbay picks it straight back up.
message.workbay.upgrade_maxed: This Workbay already has as many of those as it takes.
message.workbay.upgrade_missing: You don't have one of those to install.
message.workbay.upgrade_needs_levy: That costs %s Levy and this Workbay has %s. Raise the skim, or move more goods through your links.
tooltip.workbay.connector_unpaired: Not paired. Right-click a Workbay with this to pair it.
